import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook("/workspace/proteomics_data.xlsx", data_only=True)
ws = wb['Tumor vs Normal']

# Find ENO1
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    gene = row[2]  # gene column (3rd column, index 2)
    if gene and gene.strip().upper() == 'ENO1':
        protein = row[0]
        desc = row[1]
        normal = row[4]
        tumor = row[5]
        log2fc = row[8]
        pval = row[9]
        adjp = row[10]
        print(f"Found ENO1:")
        print(f"  Protein: {protein}")
        print(f"  Description: {desc}")
        print(f"  Normal: {normal}")
        print(f"  Tumor: {tumor}")
        print(f"  log2FC: {log2fc}")
        print(f"  p.value: {pval}")
        print(f"  adj.Pval: {adjp}")
        print(f"  log2FC rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(float(log2fc), 2)}")
        break
else:
    print("ENO1 not found!")
PYEOF

import bioblend.galaxy

api_key = "[REDACTED_GALAXY_API_KEY]"
gi = bioblend.galaxy.GalaxyInstance(url="https://usegalaxy.org", key=api_key)

dataset_id = "f9cad7b01a4721358ca23968eabd4e86"
gi.datasets.download_dataset(dataset_id, file_path="/workspace/tumor_vs_normal.tsv", use_default_filename=False)
print("Downloaded successfully")

# Read and find ENO1
with open("/workspace/tumor_vs_normal.tsv") as f:
    header = f.readline().strip().split('\t')
    print(f"Header columns: {header}")
    for i, line in enumerate(f):
        cols = line.strip().split('\t')
        gene = cols[2] if len(cols) > 2 else ""
        if gene.strip().upper() == 'ENO1':
            print(f"\nFound ENO1 at line {i+2}:")
            for j, (h, v) in enumerate(zip(header, cols)):
                print(f"  {h}: {v}")
            log2fc = float(cols[8])
            print(f"\nlog2FC rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(log2fc, 2)}")
            break
    else:
        print("ENO1 not found!")
PYEOF
